data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (venue search and suggestion, event selection, sort, start/end times, Update Search) and its parameters, but it adds an accessibility filter step the true occurrence didn't use, omits the final Book Now, gives the step order loosely, and leaves the event-or-date choice and filter details vague, so an automation would need guesswork.
